display.title: Ahavas Yisroel Before Lag BaOmer: Hillel and the Whole Torah on One Foot
display.summary_short: A week before Lag BaOmer, Uncle Yossi explains why loving your fellow as yourself is a great rule of the Torah, with the story of Hillel, Shammai and the man on one foot.
display.summary_long: A talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, one week before Lag BaOmer, the yahrzeit of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai and the day the plague among Rabbi Akiva's students came to an end. Their mistake was not respecting one another, so we must honor each other and practice Ahavas Yisroel. 'Love your fellow as yourself' is the tenth of the Twelve Pesukim that every Tzivos Hashem soldier says daily, and Rabbi Akiva called it a great rule of the Torah. Uncle Yossi tells how a man asked to be taught the whole Torah while standing on one foot: strict Shammai sent him away, but patient Hillel answered calmly that loving your fellow is the whole Torah and the rest explains it. Unity built on the one Torah is what Moshiach is waiting for, and through loving every Jew we keep all the other mitzvos better.
display.lesson: Love your fellow as yourself and look for the good in others; that is the whole Torah and it brings Moshiach.
